title: Algorithm analysis of John Ward's Mars anomalies

tellings.quote:
I apply some algorithms
to evaluate that evaluate the likelihood
that they can be naturally formed
fractal and texture-based algorithms.

plain: An unnamed researcher, speaking as a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says he ran computer methods that measure fractal patterns and surface texture on strange features on Mars that a man named John Ward had found. The features came from photos taken by NASA spacecraft orbiting Mars, the Mars Global Surveyor and the HiRISE camera, and the methods estimate how likely they are to have formed naturally. If they are not natural, it would suggest someone made them.
